survey: An astronaut helmet on a display base, seen from three-quarters with the front turned toward the viewer's left. Main parts: (1) a rounded blue shell with white panels, including a white band over the crown and a curved white panel down the right side, each edged with raised orange trim; (2) a large oval amber visor set into the front of the shell, held by a thick orange tube rim; (3) a chrome neck ring where the bottom of the shell sits; (4) a white cylindrical stand with a red stripe, resting flat on a purple shelf with a contact shadow. The crown trim lines meet the visor rim at the top. The side trim runs down to the neck ring. The shell sits inside the chrome ring, and the stand is centred under it and touches the shelf. There are no cables, hoses or loose parts. The shell is a little egg-shaped, but that is normal simplification.

errors.where: Orange visor rim, right side, at about the 3 o'clock position
errors.what: The tube rim has a visible cut or seam, as if two rim pieces were butted together slightly out of line. A real visor seal is one continuous ring, so the gap looks like a break in the part.

fix: Make the orange visor rim one smooth, continuous ring all the way around the visor, with no seam, cut or step on its right side.
